author: Dev
method: rip-up and reroute from a negotiated-congestion start: neighbourhoods of detoured nets are rerouted one net at a time, choosing among 7 routing modes by a search guided by a ~10M-parameter CNN + net-interaction network; a reroute is kept only if delay does not increase; up to 20 min per case on one worker
hardware: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition(Colab G4)
